% --- About ---
\newcommand{\cvAbout}{%
Frontend developer with 4+ years of experience building web apps in React, Next.js and TypeScript.
At Tavana I work on an e-commerce platform used by 20,000+ people a day. I build and maintain our component library, handle data fetching and state with React Query, Redux Toolkit and Zustand, and work on page speed.
